title: 安全啟動與韌體信任鏈
titleEn: Secure boot and firmware chains of trust
summary: 以可信根、映像驗證與可復原更新連結 16 個技術單元，新增 32 步原理、架構、假想算例、實驗設計與失效驗證。 原有步驟及進度識別完整保留。
summaryEn: Sixteen technical units connect roots of trust, image verification and recoverable updates through 32 new tasks covering principles, architecture, assumed calculations, experiment design and failure validation. Existing steps and progress identities are preserved.
scope: 公開原理的雙語工程教育；工作臺是概念模擬，不是特定廠商產品的完整模擬器。數值為自行設定的教學假設。實驗僅限離線模型、自己的隔離環境或明確授權的測試資料；不掃描或改動真實第三方系統，未測平臺保留未決。
scopeEn: Bilingual engineering education from public principles; the workbench is a conceptual simulation, not a complete simulator of any vendor product. Inputs are original teaching assumptions. Experiments use offline models, owned isolated environments or explicitly authorized test data, never scan/modify third-party systems and leave untested platforms unresolved.

labelsEn: Root of trust and boot graph

stages.title: 信任架構
stages.description: 盤點啟動路徑與授權，不把所有韌體保護都等同 UEFI Secure Boot。
stages.descriptionEn: Inventory boot paths and authority without equating all firmware protection with UEFI Secure Boot.

steps.title: 盤點啟動元件與信任邊界
steps.titleEn: Inventory boot components and trust boundaries
steps.objective: 畫出韌體、載入器、核心及每次驗證先於執行的邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Map firmware, loader and kernel with verification boundaries before execution.
steps.instruction: 在隔離的紙上模型排列信任根、平台韌體、UEFI 載入器與作業系統核心。為每次交接標明驗證者、被驗證資料與失敗處置；把硬體韌體保護與 UEFI 映像政策分開。
steps.instructionEn: In an isolated paper model, order the root of trust, platform firmware, UEFI loader and OS kernel. Label verifier, verified data and failure handling at each handoff, separating firmware protection from UEFI image policy.
steps.observation: 沒有驗證的交接點，不能只因前一段可信就宣稱後一段可信。
steps.observationEn: An unverified handoff does not become trusted merely because its predecessor is trusted.
steps.failure: 把「已開啟 Secure Boot」視為所有裝置韌體都受保護，會漏掉範圍外元件。
steps.failureEn: Treating enabled Secure Boot as protection for every device firmware overlooks components outside its scope.
steps.check: 每條執行箭頭前都有對應驗證或明確列出的架構假設。
steps.checkEn: Precede every execution edge with verification or an explicitly recorded architectural assumption.

knowledge.title: 信任鏈
knowledge.text: 信任需要逐段建立，並以受保護的起點作基礎。
knowledge.textEn: Trust is established across successive stages from a protected starting point.

knowledge.title: 保護範圍
knowledge.text: UEFI 映像驗證與平台全部韌體的完整性是相關但不同的範圍。
knowledge.textEn: UEFI image verification and integrity of all platform firmware are related but distinct scopes.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「安全啟動與韌體信任鏈」的「盤點啟動元件與信任邊界」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出輸入資料、處理狀態、傳輸與輸出的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「算力中心：核心不是答案」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與輸入版本、時間追蹤、資源計數與可重播的小型測試的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Inventory boot components and trust boundaries” in “Secure boot and firmware chains of trust”. Draw the input, processing state, transport and output boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Compute Center: Cores Are Not the Answer” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for input version, time traces, resource counters and a replayable small test, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 載入器可信，是否足以直接執行任何未驗證核心？
quiz.questionEn: Does a trusted loader justify executing any unverified kernel?
options: 不足，下一段仍需依其信任政策驗證。
足夠，前一段可信就等同所有後續輸入都受授權。
足夠，只要核心雜湊由該核心自己宣告即可。
optionsEn: No; the next stage still needs verification under its trust policy.
Yes; trust in the previous stage authorizes all subsequent inputs.
Yes; the kernel only needs to declare its own hash.
quiz.explanation: 不足，下一段仍需依其信任政策驗證。 信任需要逐段建立，並以受保護的起點作基礎。
quiz.explanationEn: No; the next stage still needs verification under its trust policy. Trust is established across successive stages from a protected starting point.

steps.title: 定義信任根與受保護狀態
steps.titleEn: Define roots of trust and protected state
steps.objective: 辨認不能由待驗證軟體自行改寫的信任依據。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify trust evidence that unverified software cannot rewrite at will.
steps.instruction: 在架構圖標出驗證程式、信任金鑰、版本狀態與復原根。對每項提出「誰能修改」及「修改如何授權」兩個問題，使用假設權限表而不操作真實韌體。
steps.instructionEn: Mark verifier code, trust keys, version state and recovery roots. For each, ask who can modify it and how changes are authorized, using a hypothetical permission table rather than modifying real firmware.
steps.observation: 若被驗證映像也能任意替換驗證金鑰，信任會形成循環。
steps.observationEn: If the image under review can freely replace its verification key, trust becomes circular.
steps.failure: 僅把金鑰檔案命名為 root 並不提供保護；需說明保護機制。
steps.failureEn: Naming a key file root provides no protection; explain the protection mechanism.
steps.check: 每個信任依據都有保護位置、修改權限與授權路徑。
steps.checkEn: Give each trust anchor a protected location, modification authority and authorization path.

knowledge.title: 信任起點
knowledge.text: 信任根的可靠性不能完全依賴它所驗證的軟體。
knowledge.textEn: A root’s reliability cannot depend entirely on the software it verifies.

knowledge.title: 受控更新
knowledge.text: 可更新的信任資料仍需要明確、受驗證的變更規則。
knowledge.textEn: Updatable trust data still need explicit authenticated change rules.

quiz.question: 若未驗證映像可以替換自己的信任金鑰，問題是什麼？
quiz.questionEn: What is wrong if an unverified image can replace its own trust key?
options: 只要更換後的金鑰格式正確，就不影響安全。
它可自行建立接受自己的依據，破壞信任邊界。
金鑰可修改代表系統自動具備安全更新能力。
optionsEn: A correctly formatted replacement key cannot affect security.
It can manufacture its own acceptance basis, breaking the trust boundary.
A modifiable key automatically provides secure update capability.
quiz.explanation: 它可自行建立接受自己的依據，破壞信任邊界。 信任根的可靠性不能完全依賴它所驗證的軟體。
quiz.explanationEn: It can manufacture its own acceptance basis, breaking the trust boundary. A root’s reliability cannot depend entirely on the software it verifies.

steps.title: 區分 PK、KEK、db 與 dbx
steps.titleEn: Separate PK, KEK, db and dbx
steps.objective: 把平台所有權、政策更新與映像允許權限分開。
steps.objectiveEn: Separate platform ownership, policy updates and image authorization.
steps.instruction: 建立四張權限卡，分別對應平台金鑰、金鑰交換金鑰、允許資料庫與禁止資料庫。用箭頭表示誰能授權更新哪個資料庫，另畫執行映像的判斷路徑。
steps.instructionEn: Create cards for PK, KEK, the allowed database and the forbidden database. Draw policy-update authorization arrows separately from the path used to decide whether an image executes.
steps.observation: 可以授權更新資料庫的金鑰，不等於自動允許所有由它簽署的執行映像。
steps.observationEn: A key authorized to update a database does not automatically authorize every executable it signs.
steps.failure: 把 PK 當成每個作業系統映像唯一簽署者，會混淆管理權與執行權。
steps.failureEn: Treating PK as the sole signer of every OS image confuses policy management with execution authorization.
steps.check: 能用一張圖區分金鑰管理與映像驗證兩條路徑。
steps.checkEn: Distinguish key-management and image-verification paths in one diagram.

knowledge.title: 權限分工
knowledge.text: UEFI 政策將平台控制、政策更新及映像信任資料分成不同角色。
knowledge.textEn: UEFI policy separates platform control, policy updates and image trust data into distinct roles.

knowledge.title: 最小授權
knowledge.text: 一種權限不能被推定為所有其他權限。
knowledge.textEn: One form of authority must not be assumed to grant every other authority.

quiz.question: KEK 的主要角色較接近哪個描述？
quiz.questionEn: Which description best matches the role of KEK?
options: 直接提供所有作業系統核心的執行允許清單。
記錄裝置目前韌體的量測雜湊。
授權相關安全啟動資料庫的更新。
optionsEn: Directly serving as the execution allow list for every OS kernel.
Recording measured hashes of the current device firmware.
Authorizing updates to the relevant Secure Boot databases.
quiz.explanation: 授權相關安全啟動資料庫的更新。 UEFI 政策將平台控制、政策更新及映像信任資料分成不同角色。
quiz.explanationEn: Authorizing updates to the relevant Secure Boot databases. UEFI policy separates platform control, policy updates and image trust data into distinct roles.

steps.title: 比較雜湊完整性與簽章授權
steps.titleEn: Compare hash integrity and signature authorization
steps.objective: 區分內容識別與可信發布者的判定。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish content identification from trusted-publisher authorization.
steps.instruction: 在紙上為原始映像與修改一位元的映像各指定不同雜湊，再加入可信與未知簽署者兩種卡片。分別判斷內容是否一致、簽章是否可驗證及簽署者是否受政策信任。
steps.instructionEn: Assign distinct hypothetical hashes to an original image and a one-bit modification, then add trusted and unknown signer cards. Separately judge content integrity, signature verification and policy trust in the signer.
steps.observation: 可算出雜湊，不代表該雜湊來自可信來源；簽章可驗證也仍需政策授權。
steps.observationEn: Computing a hash does not establish its trusted origin; a verifiable signature still needs policy authorization.
steps.failure: 從同一未知來源下載映像與雜湊，不能單靠兩者一致建立發布者信任。
steps.failureEn: An image and hash from the same unknown source do not establish publisher trust simply by matching.
steps.check: 每個接受結論同時說明內容驗證與信任來源。
steps.checkEn: Explain both integrity verification and trust provenance for each acceptance decision.

knowledge.title: 不同問題
knowledge.text: 雜湊描述內容，簽章與信任政策協助判斷授權來源。
knowledge.textEn: Hashes characterize content; signatures and trust policy help determine authorized origin.

knowledge.title: 私鑰保管
knowledge.text: 發布簽署私鑰不應隨待驗證映像交付給裝置作一般資料。
knowledge.textEn: A release-signing private key should not be distributed as ordinary data alongside the image it authenticates.

quiz.question: 映像和未知網站提供的雜湊一致，能證明什麼？
quiz.questionEn: An image matches a hash from an unknown website. What does that prove?
options: 兩者在內容識別上相符，仍未建立可信發布者。
已證明該網站是受授權的韌體發布者。
已證明此版本符合目前的撤銷與防回滾政策。
optionsEn: They agree as content identifiers, but a trusted publisher is not established.
It proves the website is an authorized firmware publisher.
It proves compliance with current revocation and rollback policies.
quiz.explanation: 兩者在內容識別上相符，仍未建立可信發布者。 雜湊描述內容，簽章與信任政策協助判斷授權來源。
quiz.explanationEn: They agree as content identifiers, but a trusted publisher is not established. Hashes characterize content; signatures and trust policy help determine authorized origin.
